explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that duplicates this theorem, and I don't expect one to exist. The statement checks the library's own certificate data: the precomputed row `row18876` should equal what `Integer.Sparse.collectBalanced GramPolynomial.keyLess` returns on `rawRow18876`. Every one of these constants is defined in the library (the OAI MUB6 Gram certificate). The proof just evaluates both sides in the kernel with `decide +kernel`. All of the content lies in the library's own definitions and data, so Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core have nothing to match. I did not search further, since there is nothing in them that this could correspond to.
